$comment: VAPP-229 (spec docs/spec/apps.md §9.3, M3): EVERY row an app causes reads "via <app>" ×4. A nullable `via_app_id` (FK apps, ON DELETE SET NULL, SYNCED) sits on `comments` (#VAPP-186, its caption = reporter-reply.json `captions.viaApp`), `issues`, `sessions` and `app_records`. The SERVER stamps it, never a client: the apps broker (`/api/mcp/apps`) runs an app's exposed tool (`run.records` / `run.action`) and, later, its automations (A1) on a server-side context naming the app (apps/web lib/emcp/via-app.ts); issues.create, sessions.send (every session row it inserts: a new root, a child, an agent's fresh thread) and the records service's create stamp that app. VAPP-231: an app's own UI writing through the viewer's client stamps it too, through a CLAIM the server checks (`claim` below). `sessions.via_app_id` is NOT `sessions.app_id` (the app an EDITOR session edits). A record's `via_app_id` is set on CREATE only (an update keeps it). RESOLVE: the id against the client's synced, non-trashed apps; an unknown or deleted app = no caption (null). TEXT: `viaAppCaption(name)` = `copy.viaApp` with `{app}` = the name, null without a name (`captionCases`); `withViaApp(text, name)` = text + `copy.separator` + that caption, the text alone without one (`appendCases`). WHERE ×4 (existing text, no new component): ISSUE DETAIL = the activity timeline's synthesized creation row, its muted tail `created the issue · {time}` gets the caption appended (`withViaApp`, so `Ana created the issue · 2h · via Timesheet`); SESSION VIEW = one muted text-xs line under the header's title / origin row (`viaAppCaption`, absent without one; the thread header itself stays caption-free, session-thread.json); DATA TAB = the By cell (app-records.json `dataTab`) = `withViaApp(recordByline(...), name)` (`Ana · via Timesheet`, one truncated line; phones' rows carry no By cell); ISSUE LIST ROWS (#VAPP-231, board and My Issues lists) = a muted tail on the title's own one-line text, `withViaApp("", name)` = ` · via Timesheet`, same size as the title, the row's muted colour, no gap of its own and no new element: the line truncates as ONE text, so on a narrow row the caption is cut first and a long title loses it entirely, the title is never squeezed for it. Mirrors: TS packages/domain-contract/src/via-app.ts, desktop domain::via_app, iOS ExpCore ViaApp.swift, Android domain/ViaApp.kt replay every case.

captionCases.name: an empty name reads as none

claim.$comment: VAPP-231 (spec docs/spec/apps.md §9.3): a host says which app a write comes from: `viaApp: {appId, version}`, version = the app's synced `publishedVersion` read at send time (a queued outbox entry reads it at replay, no outbox column). WIRE: tRPC `apps.records.upsert` / `apps.records.batch` input `viaApp`; an MCP call (`harness.mcp`, `exponential.*`) the header `header` = `{appId}@{version}`. A delete carries none: it stamps nothing. HOST ×4 (`claimCases`): no app id, an unsynced row or a never-published app = no claim; the Data tab and the CSV import are not the app's UI and send none. SERVER (TS only, `verdictCases`): the claim holds when version is 1..publishedVersion (above = a draft), the caller is a team member whose app access is not `none` and whose credential reaches the team, and the app's PUBLISHED package declares the function: `records.upsert` for records.upsert and for a batch, for an MCP call its `exponential.<noun>.<op>` (aliases and `prefix*` count) or `harness.mcp`; a records claim must also name the app written to, and a JSON-RPC batch needs every call declared. A claim only adds a caption: it never widens access, and a refused or malformed header costs the write nothing, it lands with no `via_app_id`. The broker's own stamp wins over a claim.

verdictCases.name: read access is still app access

appendCases.name: an issue list row's tail, no text before it
an issue list row without an app has no tail
issue creation tail without an app
a deleted app = the text alone
